name: Customer Relationship Management
description: System of record for customer identity, account structure, service cases, and activity history; the context provider that makes every other system personal and consistent.
roleInCenter: Single source of truth for who the customer is, what they own, and what happened before this contact.

glossary.definition: Top-level business entity owning products, billing, and entitlements
Person associated with one or more accounts, with phone/email identities
Unit of work tracking a customer issue from open to resolved disposition
Parent-child relationships for households or organizations with sub-accounts
Routing-triggered automatic display of customer context at the moment an agent answers
Chronological record of interactions and touches attached to account or case
Record of what contact and recording uses the customer has agreed to, per jurisdiction
Golden record after matching/merge across duplicates and channels
Coded contact outcome written back at wrap-up; feeds reporting and QA disposition accuracy
Headline customer state (tenure, open cases, last contact, risk flags) shown to agents in one glance

children.name: Opportunity
children.description: Sales pipeline record used by outbound and retention offers

children.name: Pre-Contact
children.description: Identity match and context prep before agent connect (data dip, screen pop)

children.name: During Contact
children.description: Live reads and writes while handling; latency matters most

children.name: Post Contact (Wrap)
children.description: Disposition, wrap codes, case updates during ACW

children.name: Background Sync
children.description: Batch identity resolution, dedupe, and cross-system reconciliation

metrics.name: Screen Pop Adoption
metrics.definition: Share of answered contacts where context displayed automatically before first response

metrics.name: Context Carry-Over Rate
metrics.definition: Share of repeat contacts where history was readable without customer re-explaining

metrics.name: Average Wrap-Up Time
metrics.definition: Mean after-contact work completing CRM logging and case updates

metrics.name: Duplicate Contact Record Rate
metrics.definition: Share of records flagged as duplicate or merge candidates

failureModes.name: Context Blindness
failureModes.signal: Customers re-explain; VOC repeat-contact drivers dominated by history gap
failureModes.mitigation: Screen pop plus context banner scan mandatory in QA rubric

failureModes.name: Swivel-Chair Logging
failureModes.signal: Wrap codes inconsistent; ACW ballooning in CRM tools with poor UX
failureModes.mitigation: Streamlined wrap flow, disposition presets from case type

failureModes.name: Identity Fragmentation
failureModes.signal: Duplicate accounts proliferating; fragmented history on new channels
failureModes.mitigation: Background matching job; channel keys normalized to master identity

failureModes.name: Consent Zoning Error
failureModes.signal: QA auto-fails around recording or outreach despite recorded consent elsewhere
failureModes.mitigation: Consent state must be surfaced in context banner with jurisdiction rules

exchanges: Case attributes retrieve contextual KM content
Campaign suppression list from consent states
